# Job Description - Enterprise Architect

> **Position**: Enterprise Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Senior Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking a talented Enterprise Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will support the creation and enforcement of our Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) for Gainwell Technologies' product portfolio and assist in the resolution of tactical architecture issues to support business strategy while positioning the company for growth and agility.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#primary-duties]

### Primary Duties

- Support the development and maintenance of the Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) to drive technology transformation
- Assist in the implementation and governance of Reference Architecture across specific business domains
- Research and evaluate new technologies and software products for alignment with ERA
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#architecture--design]

### Architecture & Design

- Design technology solutions for medium complexity projects within assigned domains
- Support development of architecture patterns and standards that guide technology solution design
- Create technical documentation and architecture artifacts for assigned projects
- Implement cloud-native solutions on AWS and Azure platforms under guidance
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#collaboration--support]

### Collaboration & Support

- Assist Sales and Product Management with technical content for RFP/RFI responses
- Support collaboration with third-party vendors and partners on application integration projects
- Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) meetings and governance processes
- Work closely with development teams to ensure architectural compliance
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#documentation--communication]

### Documentation & Communication

- Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and guidelines for assigned domains
- Present technical solutions to development teams and technical stakeholders
- Participate in knowledge sharing initiatives within the Enterprise Architecture Practice
- Document technical decisions and implementation details
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#compliance--implementation]

### Compliance & Implementation

- Ensure adherence to ERA guidelines in assigned solution designs
- Support compliance with healthcare regulations including HIPAA, MITA, and FedRAMP
- Participate in architecture governance processes and technical reviews
- Assist in monitoring architecture metrics and compliance reporting

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in relevant technical field
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 3+ years of experience in application architecture and solution design
- **Required**: 1+ years of enterprise architecture experience or related role
- **Preferred**: 2+ years of experience in healthcare technology or government systems
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#core-architecture-skills]

#### Core Architecture Skills

- Basic understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, or equivalent)
- Architecture modeling tools (Markdown, Mermaid, Lucidchart, Draw.io, UML, C4 Diagramming)
- Solution design and technical documentation
- Software development lifecycle methodologies
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#technology-expertise]

#### Technology Expertise

- Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) with basic cloud-native implementation experience
- Integration technologies, APIs, and middleware
- Database technologies and data architecture concepts
- Enterprise software systems and applications
- Programming languages and development frameworks
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#programming--development]

#### Programming & Development

- Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (Java, C#, Python, etc.)
- Understanding of software architecture patterns and design principles
- Basic experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for architecture design and analysis
- AI agents and automation tools for architecture and development workflows
page_texts.19:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Azure Fundamentals
- Industry-specific certifications (healthcare, government)

---
page_texts.21:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#industry-experience]

### Industry Experience

- Experience in healthcare technology and Medicaid systems
- Basic knowledge of government healthcare programs (Medicaid, CHIP, SNAP, TANF, WIC, LIHEAP)
- Understanding of HIPAA, MITA, and healthcare compliance requirements
- Familiarity with Health and Human Services interoperability standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, IX4HS, NIEM)
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#domain-expertise]

### Domain Expertise

- Understanding of recipient engagement design patterns for digital channels
- Knowledge of security protocols including Secure Messaging, ADA Section 508, FedRAMP
- Experience with Generative AI technologies and their application in enterprise architecture design and analysis
- Basic enterprise data management and information architecture knowledge
- Service-oriented architecture and microservices patterns
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#communication--collaboration]

### Communication & Collaboration

- Experience working with technical teams
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to present technical concepts to development teams
- Basic facilitation skills

---
page_texts.25:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **Systems Understanding**: Ability to understand system components and their relationships
- **Solution Implementation**: Capability to implement well-defined solutions
- **Technology Learning**: Skills in learning and applying new technologies
- **Problem Solving**: Ability to identify and resolve technical issues
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#business-competencies]

### Business Competencies

- **Business Awareness**: Basic understanding of business strategy and alignment
- **Stakeholder Collaboration**: Ability to work with technical stakeholder groups
- **Process Following**: Experience following established processes and procedures
- **Continuous Learning**: Commitment to professional development and growth
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/enterprise-architect.md#professional-competencies]

### Professional Competencies

- **Teamwork**: Strong collaboration and team participation skills
- **Communication**: Clear technical communication abilities
- **Initiative**: Proactive approach to learning and problem-solving
- **Adaptability**: Ability to work in changing technical environments

---

_This job description is part of Gainwell's Enterprise Architecture Practice talent acquisition framework._
